Questions

Everything you
need to know

Which Lightroom version do I need?

The presets work with Lightroom Classic (any version) and Lightroom Mobile (free app). Magic AI Tools require Lightroom Classic v12+ or the latest mobile version.

Do they work with my camera?

Yes — built and tested on Canon, but compatible with Sony, Nikon, Fujifilm, and all major cameras. You may need minor white balance or exposure tweaks depending on your system.

RAW or JPEG?

Both work. RAW files give the richest results since the preset can access the full tonal range. JPEG works too, but with slightly less flexibility.

What are the Magic AI Tools?

AI-powered local adjustments that target specific elements — subject, background, or sky — without affecting the rest of the image. Full Collection only.

How do I install the presets?

After purchase, you'll receive a full step-by-step installation guide for both Lightroom Classic and Mobile.

What is Morning Haze?

An exclusive bonus preset in the Full Collection with built-in AI masks that automatically soften skin and brighten eyes — a preset and a retouch in one click.
